name: Caym Aster
source:
Age: XX | LV 10 Reaper

The only Reaper around with a last name. A claim he pretends to not take pride of, but quite obviously does so.

While he isn't the official 'leader' of the band of misfits, he's the one usually in charge anyway. And the one responsible for all the paperwork they cause (although he likes to pass it off to Valefar.)

He's quite good with his hands at making drinks, that is.

LIKES
Bubble waffles, mixing new drinks, teasing Aina, reading, astronomy, studying flower language

DISLIKES
Paperwork, Orias's complaining, messes, papercuts, paperwork, things that make his head hurt. Paperwork.

[From [url=https://mobile.twitter.com/rosemilkstudio/status/1554213145232695297]Twitter[/url]]
